name: Ratatoskr
description: Ratatoskr is a self-hosted webmail client for any IMAP/SMTP account. One container, configured by environment variables, with data in SQLite under /data. Features: unified inbox, conversations, Web Push notifications and PWA, snooze, and dark mode. Every email is treated as hostile: server-side sanitising, sandboxed rendering, and remote images are proxied. REQUIRES HTTPS through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy) for push notifications and installing it as an app. WebSockets on /api/ws must be proxied. Set the Base URL to the public https address and keep Trust Proxy enabled.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Holds ratatoskr.db (users, accounts, settings) and cache.db (mail cache).

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the server runs as and that owns /data. The entrypoint chowns /data and drops privileges. Image default is 1000; Unraid uses 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the server runs as and that owns /data. Image default is 1000; Unraid uses 100.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Optional umask for files the server creates, e.g. 022.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public https URL users reach Ratatoskr at, e.g. https://mail.example.com. Used for the OIDC redirect URI, the cookie Secure flag and the WebSocket origin check.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Master secret, at least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48. WARNING: changing it later makes stored mail account passwords unreadable.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers. Keep true when running behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Password Login
variables.description: Optional. Enable username/password login (true/false). Leave empty for the default: true without OIDC, false with OIDC.

variables.name: Registration
variables.description: Who may create a password account: open, first (first user of an empty instance only) or closed.

variables.name: OIDC Issuer URL
variables.description: Optional OIDC. Issuer URL; the discovery document is read from it. Register ${RATATOSKR_BASE_URL}/auth/callback as the redirect URI with your provider.

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: Optional OIDC client ID.

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: Optional OIDC client secret (confidential clients).

variables.name: OIDC Label
variables.description: Optional. Provider name shown on the login button. Empty uses the default (Single sign-on).

variables.name: OIDC Scopes
variables.description: Scopes requested from the OIDC provider.

variables.name: Block Private Mail Hosts
variables.description: Refuse IMAP/SMTP hosts resolving to private/internal addresses. Leave false when your mail server is on the LAN.

variables.name: Default IMAP Host
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the IMAP host in the Add account form. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default SMTP Host
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the SMTP host in the Add account form. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default IMAP Security
variables.description: Optional. tls, starttls or none (app default: tls).

variables.name: Default SMTP Security
variables.description: Optional. tls, starttls or none (app default: tls).

variables.name: Default IMAP Port
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the IMAP port. Accepts the {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default SMTP Port
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the SMTP port. Accepts the {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default Mail Username
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the mail username. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default Email
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the email address, e.g. {username}@example.com. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default Display Name
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the sender display name. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Default Account Label
variables.description: Optional. Pre-fills the account label. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

variables.name: Cache
variables.description: Keep a local copy of each account's newest INBOX and Sent mail. false always asks the mail server.

variables.name: Cache Messages
variables.description: Newest messages kept per cached folder (50-100000).

variables.name: Cache Max Body MB
variables.description: Largest message whose content is cached. 0 keeps no message content.

variables.name: Cache Account MB
variables.description: Message content kept per account; least recently read is removed first.

variables.name: Max Message MB
variables.description: Largest message the server downloads for display.

variables.name: Max Upload MB
variables.description: Largest total attachment upload when composing.

variables.name: IMAP Idle Timeout
variables.description: Seconds before an unused pooled IMAP connection is closed.

variables.name: VAPID Subject
variables.description: Optional. Contact sent to push services. Empty uses the base URL if https, else mailto:postmaster@host.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: One of fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.
